First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Race pace. It’s a drop ride: if you can’t hold the pace, you’ll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at @jedsbikeshop the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.
Read
Fast road wheels and tires: tire width, aero wheels, wheel stiffness and comfort.

About the Hattiesburg Tuesday Night Worlds group ride

Hattiesburg Tuesday Night Worlds is a road group ride in Hattiesburg, MS. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:30 pm from Jackson Road, near Jed’s Perfect Endurance Bikes.

The local fast ride. It is a drop ride at race pace. The shop asks new riders to call first.
